items.title: Sis….You didn’t just wake up one day and decide to be “the strong one.”
items.summary: Sis….You didn’t just wake up one day and decide to be “the strong one.” Life trained you. You were probably the firstborn… or the daughter in a family where being a child was a luxury you couldn’t afford. You knew what it meant to stretch a meal, to hear “we’ll manage,” and so...
items.author: Hadram Hydara
